title: Extracting, Computing and Exploring the Parameters of Statistical Models using R
authors: Lüdecke, D., Ben-Shachar, M., Patil, I., & Makowski, D.
summary: The parameters R package extracts what a model actually estimated — coefficients, standard errors, intervals, p-values — out of any of the dozens of model classes in R and into one tidy frame, along with the bootstrapping, standardisation and dimensionality-reduction usually needed next.
